verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs describe a built-in AI agent that users can delegate work to: 'Introduction to Fin Tasks', 'Building Fin Procedures', 'Giving Fin Guidance', and pricing docs stating it 'takes action to update external systems' and 'handles tickets, cases, emails, live chat, WhatsApp, SMS.' This is core, first-party documented functionality, not a bolt-on tool.  Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence confirming delegated tasks are reliably completed in production (community commentary is skeptical/mixed rather than a concrete failure report).
